subject: Who signs the RFP and purchase order? Procurement & PO flow for Lumina
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Mehta <anika.mehta@luminahealth.com>; Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + ask: procurement path & PO flow

Hi Anika / Ravi —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the three asks we agreed on: 

1) Who signs / funds this project (economic buyer & PO owner)? You mentioned finance is involved but we didn't lock a name.
2) Procurement path: internal RFP vs. standard PO vs. contract review by legal — which route do we take?
3) Initial timeline: pilot (30 days) -> evaluation -> procurement approval target (by end of Q1).

Attached is a one‑page mutual action plan and a very high‑level SOW template that we use for pilots. Can you confirm who on your side needs the SOW (procurement, legal, finance) and the correct contact for the PO process? If easier, an intro to the PO/budget owner works — we’ll keep it short and provide the required forms.

Next steps I propose:
- You introduce the budget/PO owner (if available) this week
- Ben will share a brief security/compliance blurb for procurement (SOC2/retention)
- We’ll drop a 1‑page cost table and pilot SOW in Drive for review

Happy to jump on a 15 min call with your procurement contact if that helps speed things up.

Thanks,

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0124

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf); SOW-template-lumina.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Anika Mehta <anika.mehta@luminahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@luminahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: procurement path & PO flow

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the recap and the docs — helpful. Quick answers: 

• Economic/budget owner: Michael Zhao, VP Finance (michael.zhao@luminahealth.com). He signs off on pilots > $50k. For the pilot we're proposing (~$22k) he wants a short justification and a PO routed via procurement.

• Procurement path: We typically do a standard PO for pilots and then RFP for larger deals. Procurement prefers a one‑page summary and a SOC2 artifact in the packet.

• Legal: only needs to review non‑standard T&Cs; for a PO they usually don't get involved.

I can make intros to both Michael and procurement (procurement@luminahealth.com). I’ll introduce Michael on Thursday morning — any materials you want me to include in that intro? A 1‑paragraph justification and the mutual action plan would be useful.

—Anika
Product Lead, Data & Analytics
Lumina Health

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Security blurbs + procurement checklist

Anika —

Following up with a couple of short artifacts procurement typically asks for:

- SOC 2: we can provide the SOC2 report summary and controls map (redacted).
- Data handling: short note on retention, encryption-at-rest and in-transit, and that we do not persist customer PII beyond session unless requested.
- Standard procurement checklist: required PO fields, invoicing cadence, billing contact.

I’ve uploaded a 1‑page security summary and a procurement checklist to the Drive link Grace shared. If procurement wants more, we can run a short Q&A with our InfoSec team.

Ben Carter
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment references: security_onepager.pdf (application/pdf); procurement_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Mehta <anika.mehta@luminahealth.com>, Michael Zhao <michael.zhao@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: Michael, procurement — brief ask and pilot PO path (Lumina)

Michael / Procurement team —

Thanks for taking a minute. Anika looped me in as the best contact for the proof‑of‑value pilot we discussed. Super short: we propose a 30‑day pilot to validate latency and cost at scale (Redwood handles inference hosting + optional private deployment). Estimated pilot fee: $22,000 (one‑time).

What we'd like from you:
- Confirmation of PO contact and required PO fields
- Any procurement-specific forms you need attached to the PO
- Preferred invoicing cadence (Net 30 is typical for us)

I've attached a one‑page mutual action plan and a proposed SOW for the pilot. Ben has uploaded security artifacts to the shared Drive link for procurement review. If you prefer, we can schedule a 15 minute call today to go through required fields and get the PO issued.

If you can reply with the correct PO recipient and whether an SOW is required before PO issuance, we'll prepare the packet and send a formal PO-ready invoice.

Thanks — looking forward to working through the process.

Best,

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
